input.summary: Deel is a global payroll, HR and compliance platform that raised a $300M Series E at a $17.3B valuation in October 2025. It reports over $1B ARR, three consecutive years of profitability, and strong multi-product adoption. It is hiring broadly (248 open roles) and says it will invest in AI-powered payroll/HR and global infrastructure.

facts.claim: Deel announced a $300M Series E at a $17.3B valuation, co-led by new investor Ribbit Capital with Andreessen Horowitz and Coatue Management.

We’re thrilled to welcome Ribbit Capital as a new investor, co-leading this round alongside our long-time partners Andreessen Horowitz and Coatue Management.

facts.claim: Deel surpassed $1B ARR in 2025, marked three consecutive years of profitability, and hit its first $100M revenue month in September.

input.summary: Stripe is a programmable financial infrastructure company serving more than 5 million businesses, with $1.9T in payments volume in 2025. Its recent push is on agentic commerce (ACP, Agentic Commerce Suite) and stablecoins (Open Issuance, Treasury). It also ships growth-oriented tools such as Adaptive Pricing, app-to-web payments and Radar trial-fraud protection.

facts.claim: Stripe says more than 5 million businesses build on it, and they process trillions of dollars a year, around 1.7% of global GDP.
evidence: More than 5 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth.
They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP.

facts.claim: Businesses on Stripe generated $1.9T in payments volume in 2025, and Stripe's annual letter highlights steeper growth for newer businesses and faster international expansion.
evidence: Businesses on Stripe generated $1.9T in 2025.
Our annual letter explores the trends defining the internet economy—including steeper growth for newer businesses, faster international expansion, stablecoin progress, agentic commerce, and more.

facts.claim: Over Black Friday through Cyber Monday 2025, Stripe processed more than $40B with 99.9999% uptime.
evidence: From Black Friday through Cyber Monday 2025, Stripe processed more than $40B for businesses while maintaining a 99.9999% uptime.

facts.claim: On Dec 11, 2025 Stripe launched the Agentic Commerce Suite, which lets businesses sell across multiple AI agents with a single integration. Named adopters include Coach, Kate Spade, URBN, Revolve and Ashley Furniture, plus platforms such as Wix, Etsy and Squarespace.
evidence: Agentic Commerce Suite removes that complexity with a low-code solution for businesses, letting them sell across AI agents with a single integration.
Businesses including Coach, Kate Spade, URBN (including Anthropologie, Free People, and Urban Outfitters), Revolve, Ashley Furniture, Halara, ABT Electronics, and Nectar

facts.claim: Stripe and OpenAI released the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), an open standard that powers Instant Checkout in ChatGPT. Stripe is also testing its agentic commerce solutions with partners including Microsoft Copilot, Anthropic and Perplexity.
evidence: Stripe and OpenAI yesterday released the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)—a new standard that already powers the new Instant Checkout in ChatGPT.
early partners including Microsoft Copilot, Anthropic, Perplexity, Vercel, Lovable, Replit, and Manus

facts.claim: At Stripe Tour New York (Sept 30, 2025), Stripe launched Open Issuance, which lets any business launch its own stablecoin. It is powered by Bridge, which Stripe acquired at the start of 2025.
evidence: Open Issuance enables any business to launch and manage their own stablecoin with just a few lines of code.
a new platform powered by Bridge, the leading stablecoin infrastructure company Stripe acquired at the start of this year

facts.claim: Stripe's New York launches included growth-focused tools: an app-to-web payments flow that saves some businesses up to 90% on payment costs, Adaptive Pricing for 150 markets, and Radar blocking up to 62% of trial fraud.

Adaptive Pricing, which localizes checkout prices for 150 markets without additional Stripe fees.
